bibliography.title: How Many Different Outputs Can a Transformer Generate?

sections.title: 4. The Sequences that are Accessible to a Transformer
Appendix D. Permutation-Invariant Norms and Wasserstein Distances
Appendix E. Arbitrary Prompt Length via Elementary Operations
Appendix F. Theoretical Slope of the Cramming Task for Various Supports
Appendix H. Computing the Cell Volume Distribution

abstract_sentences.text: We study how we can leverage only a handful of characteristics of a transformer’s architecture to closely predict the number of different sequences it can output, both qualitatively and quantitatively.
We provide an upper bound depending on the length of the prompt, which we show empirically to be tight up to a factor less than 10, across architectures and model sizes.
Our analysis also provides a theoretical explanation for previously observed empirical failures of transformers on simple sequence tasks—such as copying and cramming.

Formally, we prove that (i) the maximal length of accessible sequences (those that the transformer can output for some prompt) grows linearly with the prompt length, (ii) beyond a critical threshold, the proportion of accessible sequences decays exponentially with sequence length, and (iii) the linear coefficient relating prompt length to accessible sequence length admits a theoretical upper bound.
Notably, these results hold even with unbounded context and computation time.

experimental_design.name: predeclared empirical predictions
experimental_design.description: Section 5 明确列出固定 m 的 sharp threshold、阈值随 m 线性与 C upper bound 三项预测，并将 arbitrary-prompt saturation 用 copying 间接展示。

experimental_design.name: cramming intervention
experimental_design.description: 冻结模型参数，只优化长度 m 的 continuous soft prompt Y；可达性的 operational test 是从 learned Y 的 greedy exact match。

experimental_design.name: targets and aggregation
experimental_design.description: targets 是 PG19 contiguous spans 或 vocabulary subset 的 uniform i.i.d. random strings；每个 (n,m) 以 20 targets 的 mean success rate 聚合。

experimental_design.name: model families
experimental_design.description: 覆盖 Pythia、Qwen-2.5、Llama-3.2 和 Gemma-3，包含多个参数规模。

experimental_design.name: support geometry
experimental_design.description: 用 Ball、Cone、axis-aligned Ellipsoid 包络 embedding support，并以 Monte Carlo prompt samples 估计上界参数。

experimental_design.name: optimizer and hardware
experimental_design.description: Appendix G.3 指定 Adam、3000 steps、learning rate 0.01、weight decay 0.01 和 2 NVIDIA H100 GPUs。

experimental_design.name: copying-length protocol
experimental_design.description: 在长度至 50 的 synthetic exact-copying strings 上 fine-tune，达到 100% exact match 或 10K steps 停止，然后评估更长未见 strings。

experimental_design.name: cell-volume Monte Carlo
experimental_design.description: 在 ellipsoid support 内 uniform-in-volume sample，通过 greedy decoder token frequency 估计 cell volumes，Appendix 给 N=50M。

experimental_design.name: random seeds and intervals
experimental_design.description: PDF 报告 20-target mean、N 和 curve fits，但没有在主文或附录报告 random seeds、confidence intervals、p-values、bootstrap 或 multiplicity correction。

experimental_design.name: method-comparison baseline
experimental_design.description: 经验比较围绕 target distribution、模型 family 和 support enclosure；没有另一个 prompt-optimization method 或 architecture-level baseline 的配对性能表。

claim_closure.claim: 每个 Transformer 只能输出有限可达序列。
claim_closure.method_response: Definitions 4.1–4.2 把可达性转成 prompt regions 与 packing。
claim_closure.evidence_response: Theorem 4.10 和 Appendix E 给条件性有限上界；没有 direct empirical capacity measurement。
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Section 6 重述 most sequences become inaccessible。

claim_closure.claim: 固定 m 后可达比例出现指数衰减。
claim_closure.method_response: Corollary 4.7 由 packing upper bound 与 |V|^n 导出衰减。
claim_closure.evidence_response: Figure 2 显示 sharp transition；经验拟合为 sigmoid。

claim_closure.claim: 阈值随 m 近线性增长。
claim_closure.method_response: Corollary 4.7 给 m 的线性 threshold expression。
claim_closure.evidence_response: Figure 2c 的 n50(m) linear fits 给 R²=0.999 和 0.995。
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Section 6 表述 accessible length grows at most linearly。

claim_closure.claim: architecture formula 能近似预测 thresholds。
claim_closure.method_response: Appendix F 从 support geometry 和 cell-volume distribution 推导 slope proxies。
claim_closure.evidence_response: Table 1 报 ratio，但多个单元格高于摘要 less-than-10 表述。
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Section 6 将 capability 信息归因于 embedding geometry。

evidence.anchor: Ratio between the theoretical upper bound

claim_closure.claim: 理论解释 copying 与 cramming 的失败。
claim_closure.method_response: accessible-region mechanism 和 arbitrary-prompt theorem 连接 long sequences 与 small regions。
claim_closure.evidence_response: Figure 4 只在 synthetic copying-length task 中给出 sharp transition。
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Section 6 明说 explaining empirical failure。

claim_closure.claim: 结论在 unbounded context and computation 下保持。
claim_closure.method_response: Mean-field Assumption 4.9、Theorem 4.10 与 elementary-operation extension 承担该版本。
claim_closure.evidence_response: Section 7 明确没有 empirical evaluation of Theorem 4.10。
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Section 6 重复这一广域 limitation。

limitations.name: uniform finite precision
limitations.description: Assumption 4.3 uses a uniform grid although fp16 spacing changes with exponent；Appendix C.2 and G.2 give a refinement。

limitations.name: fully used ball and equal-volume cells
limitations.description: Section 4.1 identifies these as two crucial worst-case assumptions；Sections 5.2–5.3 relax them empirically。

limitations.name: arbitrary-prompt condition
limitations.description: Assumption 4.9 is explicitly called non-trivial；Appendix D supplies scaling intuition and Appendix E supplies a different elementary-operation condition。

limitations.name: cramming compute cost
limitations.description: 随着 m 增大，cramming 被称为 prohibitively expensive；论文因而用 copying task 间接检验 arbitrary-length prediction。

limitations.name: unmeasured arbitrary-length theorem and lower bounds
limitations.description: Section 7 将 Theorem 4.10 的 empirical evaluation 与 theoretical lower bounds 列为 future work。

limitations.name: statistical and optimization uncertainty
limitations.description: 20-target mean、sigmoid fits 与一套 optimizer hyperparameters 没有伴随 seeds、intervals、restarts 或 search-sensitivity 结果。

adverse_presentation_strategies.name: uncertainty display

final_judgment.single_storyline: Finite precision 与 bounded representation geometry 让 greedy-decoding prompt regions 可被 packing number 限制；固定 prompt budget 因而只支撑线性增长的 accessible length，arbitrary-length 版本另需 Wasserstein 或 elementary-operation 条件。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 accessible-sequence definition、两套核心假设和定理、cramming loss / exact-match criterion、Figure 2、Table 1 与 Figure 4，读者可据此判断对象、条件与主要现象。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 证明、precision refinement、optimizer / hardware、support sampling、cell-volume Monte Carlo、跨模型 curves、support convergence 和 volume distributions 被移入 Appendix；检查 tightness 与 assumption validity 时需要读取 C–H。
final_judgment.best_pattern: 先用具有 epsilon 邻域的 prompt region 定义可达性，再用 packing number 导出长度上界，最后把同一变量映射为 n50、support geometry 和 copying transition，使 Figure 1、Corollary 4.7 与 Figure 2 直接对应。
final_judgment.largest_gap: arbitrary-length claim 依赖 non-trivial Assumption 4.9 或 elementary-operation condition，正文没有直接评估 Theorem 4.10；摘要的 less-than-ten 也需与 Table 1 的全表数字一起解读。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 架构级 limitation 论文应把能力对象定义为可计数或可度量 region，明确理论量到实验判定量的映射，并让每张经验图对应一个具体推论。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适合有明确 representation space、稳定判定和可控 input budget 的模型；全局 precision、搜索可达性或跨长度 mean-field 假设仍需同屏给出条件、直接检验和不确定性。
